threads.title: Open the Mina SSV2 bug tickets

replay.spoken: Over in yapd, the replay fix is in and the tests pass, sir.
replay.message: Fixed the replay bug: the menu now replays the last update. All 212 tests pass. The branch is two commits behind master.

rig.spoken: Over in yapd on rig, the replay fix is in and the tests pass, sir.
rig.message: Fixed the replay bug on rig: the menu now replays the last update. All 212 tests pass. The branch is two commits behind master.

tezos.spoken: The Tezos migration finished, sir: all forty tests pass.
tezos.message: The Tezos migration is done. All 40 tests pass and the fee rounding now matches TzKT.

repeat.spoken: The Tezos migration stopped halfway, sir. Shall I repeat the migration or skip it?
repeat.message: The migration stopped halfway through the fee tables. Shall I repeat the migration from the start, or skip it and move on to the tests?

deploy.spoken: The staging deploy needs you, sir: cancel the run, or keep going?
deploy.message:
The staging deploy hit a schema drift warning. Which should I do?
1. Cancel the run
2. Keep going

merge.spoken: Over in yapd, the PR is up. Shall I merge it, sir?
merge.message: The pull request is up and green. Shall I merge it?

redirect.spoken: Codex on yapd fixed the login redirect and the tests pass, sir. Should it merge the pull request now, sir?
redirect.message: Fixed the login redirect; all tests pass. Should I merge the pull request now?

auth.spoken: Over in yapd, the auth migration is done. Should I merge the auth migration PR now, sir? I also cleared the CI cache, which was stale.
auth.message: The auth migration is done and reviewed. Should I merge the PR now? I also cleared the CI cache, which was stale.

statement.spoken: Over in yapd, it wants your go-ahead to merge the pull request. Meanwhile the docs build is green and the changelog is updated, sir.
statement.message: Ready to merge the pull request once you give the go-ahead. The docs build is green and the changelog is updated.

progress.spoken: Over in yapd, the loader rewrite is a third of the way through, sir, with the cache layer next.
progress.message: Progress: the loader rewrite is about a third done. Next up is the cache layer.

failure.spoken: The Tezos migration failed, sir: the fee tests broke after the rounding change, and nothing was merged.
failure.message: The migration failed: the fee tests broke after the rounding change. Nothing was merged.

release.spoken: Over in yapd, the release is tagged. Should it merge the release pull request now, sir? And should it delete the release branch after?
release.message: The release is tagged. Should I merge the release pull request now? And should I delete the release branch afterwards?

claude.spoken: Claude on yapd says the PR is ready, sir.
claude.message: The pull request is ready for review.

cases.note: an update tied to its thread: a send to its own thread, through pass
a hooked update: a send to its own session, through pass and its waiting hook
a rig update with only its owner: a send to its own session, through pass
an untied session: a send to its own session, through pass
over an untied update: the rebase through pass, the Mina one's through Hands, never its own thread through Hands

cases.note: another thread over a Tezos update: a send to the Mina one, never the Tezos agent
cases.heard: Tell the Mina one to wait.

cases.note: the same said three times, as a Whisper loop: the same send, never resume
cases.heard: Tell the Mina one to wait. Tell the Mina one to wait. Tell the Mina one to wait.

cases.note: show me that: shown, never sent to the agent
say that again: played again with no model
muting another thread over an update: muted in one model call, the Brain's, never sent
catching up over an update: the catch-up, never sent
repeat it to an update that asks whether to repeat: the Responder's, never said again
an option's name over an update whose thread waits on that question: never stops the run
a yes two seconds after an update that asked: quick's send at once
a yes five seconds after an update that asked: from batch 2, worked out by the model, never sent at once
